## Producing results and plots from simulated data

### Libraries

```{r, echo=FALSE}
library(AgeReading)
library(rstan)
library(ggplot2)
require(gridExtra)
library(verification)
```

### Loading result files and compute numbers at age

```{r}
Amin=3;Amax=12
A = Amax-Amin+1
data(Herring_D_boot)
data(HerringSurvey)

##Comparing estimated xi^1 with truth
load("../../save_results/fitcomb0.year500000.RData")              #reader dependent age errors
xi1 = apply(rstan::extract(fitcomb0.year,pars="xi1")$xi1,c(2,3),mean)
load("../../save_results/res0fit0.RData")
#load("../save_results/res1fit1.RData")

load("../../save_results/simfitcomb0.year100000.RData")              #reader dependent age errors
foo = rstan::extract(simfitcomb0.year)$xi1
res1 = Make_Numfish_sample(foo,Herring_D_boot,HerringSurvey$stratayearindex)

load("../../save_results/sim2fitcomb1.year100000.RData")              #reader dependent age errors
foo = rstan::extract(sim2fitcomb1.year)$xi1
res2 = Make_Numfish_sample(foo,Herring_D_boot,HerringSurvey$stratayearindex)


```

### Computing true numbers at age

```{r}
yearstrat = list(y1=c(1:6),y2=c(7:11),y3=c(12:15))
##CRSP:
data(Herring_D_boot)
K=15
crpsxi = array(NA,c(K,A,4))
Dmean = aggregate(Herring_D_boot$Abundance,list(Herring_D_boot$unitstrat),FUN=mean)$x
Ntrue = array(NA,c(3,A))
for(y in 1:3)
{
  Dy = Herring_D_boot[Herring_D_boot$Year==(2020+y),]
  Dmean = aggregate(Dy$Abundance,list(Dy$unitstrat),FUN=mean)$x
  for(a in 1:A)
   Ntrue[y,a] = sum(Dmean*xi1[yearstrat[[y]],a])
}

```

### Plot xi1est

```{r}
for(k in 1:15) {
  q = apply(xi1.est[, k, ], 2, quantile, probs = c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975))

  df = data.frame(
    age = 2 + 1:A,
    q1 = q[1, ],
    q2 = q[2, ],
    q3 = q[3, ],
    xi1true = xi1[k, ]
  )

  metr[k] = mean(xi1[k, ] >= q[1, ] & xi1[k, ] <= q[3, ])

  l[[k]] = ggplot(df, aes(age, q2)) +
    geom_ribbon(
      aes(ymin = q1, ymax = q3),
      fill = "red",
      alpha = 0.2,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_line(aes(colour = "Estimate")) +
    geom_line(aes(y = xi1true, colour = "True")) +
    scale_colour_manual(
      name = NULL,
      values = c(
        "Estimate" = "red",
        "True" = "black"
      )
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 0.85)) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(3, 5, 7, 9, 11)) +
    theme(
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_blank(),

      # Show it only on the first panel:
      legend.position = if (k == 1) "inside" else "none",
      legend.position.inside = c(0.98, 0.98),
      legend.justification = c(1, 1),
      # Make the legend compact:
      legend.text = element_text(size = 7),
      legend.key.height = grid::unit(0.3, "cm"),
      legend.key.width = grid::unit(0.7, "cm"),
      legend.spacing.y = grid::unit(0.05, "cm"),
      legend.background = element_rect(
        fill = "white",
        colour = "black",
        linewidth = 0.2
      ),
      legend.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2)
    ) +
    guides(
      colour = guide_legend(
        override.aes = list(linewidth = 0.6)
      )
    ) +
    ggtitle(tit[k])
}
legend.position = if (k == 1) "inside" else "none"
pdf("Sim_fit0_xi1est_2.pdf",height=5,width=10)
grid.arrange(l[[1]],l[[2]],l[[3]],l[[4]],l[[5]],l[[6]],
             l[[7]],l[[8]],l[[9]],l[[10]],l[[11]],l[[12]],
             l[[13]],l[[14]],l[[15]],ncol=5,nrow=3)
dev.off()
```

### Comparing estimated against "true" N(y,a)

```{r}
for(y in 1:3) {

  df = data.frame(age = 2 + 1:A,N11 = f[1, y, ] / 10^9,N12 = f[2, y, ] / 10^9,N13 = f[3, y, ] / 10^9,
    N21 = f2[1, y, ] / 10^9,N22 = f2[2, y, ] / 10^9,N23 = f2[3, y, ] / 10^9,Ntrue = Ntrue[y, ] / 10^9)

  metr[y, 1] = sum(Ntrue[y, ] >= f[1, y, ] & Ntrue[y, ] <= f[3, y, ])
  metr[y, 2] = sum(Ntrue[y, ] >= f2[1, y, ] & Ntrue[y, ] <= f2[3, y, ])

  l[[y]] = ggplot(df, aes(age, N12)) +

    # Intervals: no legend entries
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = N21, ymax = N23),fill = "green", alpha = 0.3, show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = N11, ymax = N13),fill = "red", alpha = 0.3, show.legend = FALSE) +

    # Lines included in the legend
    geom_line(aes(colour = "reader-dependent")) +
    geom_line(aes(y = N22, colour = "reader-independent")) +

    # True line: omitted from legend
    geom_line(aes(y = Ntrue), colour = "black", show.legend = FALSE) +

    scale_colour_manual(
      name = NULL,
      values = c("reader-dependent" = "red","reader-independent" = "green")) +

    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(3, 5, 7, 9, 11)) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 13)) +
    ggtitle(paste0(2020 + y)) +
    labs(x = "age", y = tit[y]) +

    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14),

      # Legend on first panel only
      legend.position = if (y == 1) "inside" else "none",
      legend.position.inside = c(0.98, 0.98),
      legend.justification = c(1, 1),

      # Smaller legend
      legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
      legend.key.height = grid::unit(0.55, "cm"),
      legend.key.width = grid::unit(1.1, "cm"),
      legend.spacing.y = grid::unit(0.12, "cm"),
      legend.background = element_rect(
        fill = "white",
        colour = "black",
        linewidth = 0.3
      ),
      legend.margin = margin(4, 4, 4, 4)
    )
}
pdf("Nest_comb_0_0_sim_true.pdf",height=4,width=12)
grid.arrange(l[[1]],l[[2]],l[[3]],nrow=1,ncol=3)
dev.off()
```


### Compute crps

```{r}
#Data: M_r: Model:M
pdf("Sim_fit1_xi1est.pdf",height=5,width=10)
par(mfrow=c(5,3),mar=c(1,1,1,1),oma=c(4,5,0,0))
xi1.est = extract(simfitcomb1.year,pars="xi1")$xi1
for(k in 1:15)
{
  q = apply(xi1.est[,k,],2,quantile,probs=c(0.025,0.5,0.975))
  matplot(2+cbind(1:A,1:A,1:A),t(q),type="l",lty=c(2,1,2),col=2,xlab="",ylab="",lwd=1.5,ylim=c(0,0.85))
  lines(2+1:A,xi1[k,])
  crpsxi[k,,2] = crps(xi1[k,],t(xi1.est[,1,]))$crps
}
mtext("Age (years)",side=1,line=1.5,outer=TRUE,cex=1.3)
mtext(expression(xi[k]^1),side=2,line=2,outer=TRUE,cex=1.3,las=0)
dev.off()

#Data: M, Model: M_r
pdf("Sim2_fit0_xi1est.pdf",height=5,width=10)

  lines(2+1:A,xi1[k,])
```

```{r}
  df = data.frame(age=c(1:A,1:A,1:A,1:A,1:A,1:A,1:A,1:A,1:A,1:A),

  df$N = df$N/10^9

  df$lty = as.factor(df$lty)
```
